g.text: Generic path for any POST/PUT in any of the 5 services. Each step is annotated with WHAT it does and WHY.
Reads X-Correlation-Id (or generates from trace ID), X-User-Id (JWT sub claim), X-Session-Id from headers.
Sets Activity.Current baggage AND opens logger.BeginScope() — every log line emitted anywhere downstream
Helper from NextAurora.ServiceDefaults wraps NewVersionedApi + MapGroup +
.RequireAuthorization() at the route group validates the JWT
Each handler ALSO checks JWT.sub == command.BuyerId
— prevents authenticated user A from submitting orders as user B.
Wolverine discovers handlers by convention (class name ends in Handler,
public HandleAsync, first param is the message type).
|— same call shape as bus.PublishAsync to a transport.
(1) Validation: if any FluentValidation rule fails →
(2) Context propagation: opens logger.BeginScope so handler logs carry the correlation/user/session IDs. For async messages,
the IDs are restored from envelope headers.
(3) AutoApplyTransactions: detects the handler uses a DbContext, opens a transaction. Entity write + outbox-row write commit
together at the end of the handler — see Diagram 3.

Constructor-injected dependencies: DbContext directly (no IFooRepository wrapper — DbContext IS Unit-of-Work, DbSet<T> IS Repository), IMessageBus, ICatalogClient (gRPC port — substituted in tests), ILogger.
Domain methods enforce invariants (Order.Create, order.MarkAsPaid). Money is calculated server-side, never trusted from client.
May cascade events (return an event → Wolverine publishes via outbox).
Handler calls context.SaveChangesAsync() directly (no repository wrapper). EF generates UPDATE

.. WHERE Id=@id AND RowVersion=@orig (SQL Server) or AND xmin=@orig (Postgres) — concurrency token in the WHERE clause. Outbox envelopes staged during the handler flush in the SAME transaction via Wolverine UseEntityFrameworkCoreTransactions.
Anywhere a handler throws, this catches it and emits
RFC 7807 ProblemDetails. Every response includes traceId so server-side logs
(e.g. order in wrong state for transition)
detail: 'Please contact support with the trace ID'
(full details logged server-side, NEVER sent to client)

Files: NextAurora.ServiceDefaults/{Middleware/CorrelationIdMiddleware.cs, Messaging/ContextPropagationMiddleware.cs, GlobalExceptionHandler.cs, Extensions.cs}, each service's Api/Program.cs + Api/Endpoints/*.cs,
each service's Application/Handlers/*.cs.Related diagrams: 3 (transactional outbox detail), 4 (EF Core query + write lifecycle).
